title: TCF corner
subtitle: A2 · Unit 10: Food, shopping and quantities

steps.title: Exam style
steps.body: These questions look like the real TCF Canada: one play, four options, one answer. A wrong and a blank answer both score zero, so always choose.

steps.fr: Je vais acheter des lentilles sèches. J'en prends un sachet pour le groupe.
steps.question: What amount will the speaker buy?
steps.explain: The speaker says un sachet; four refers to the people.

steps.fr: Je n'achète pas de boisson sans sucre. Je vais en choisir une autre pour le groupe.
steps.question: What will the speaker choose?
steps.explain: The speaker will choose another drink.

steps.fr: Le prix au kilo est plus bas pour les lentilles. J'en prends un paquet.
steps.question: Why does the shopper choose the lentils?
options: Their price per kilogram is lower
They are in a glass jar
They are the only local product
steps.explain: The speaker says their price per kilogram is lower.
The notice asks the shopper to keep the itemized receipt.
steps.promptFr: LISTE — Un bocal de sauce : 3,40 $. Promotion : 2,90 $. Reçu détaillé.

steps.explain: The menu states one serving per person.
steps.promptFr: MENU — Repas sans gluten : lentilles, tomates et sauce maison. Quantité : une portion individuelle.

steps.prompt: What is mentioned for a product exchange?
steps.explain: The notice mentions the return policy and itemized receipt.
steps.promptFr: AVIS — Politique de retour : pour échanger un produit, un reçu détaillé.
